tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: All parameters are within normal limits except for elevated creatinine, indicating impaired renal function. This suggests possible chronic kidney disease or acute kidney injury. Correlation with clinical findings and further renal assessment are recommended. Other electrolytes and metabolic parameters are stable.
